jobs.description:
I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.

jobs.description:
Join us and become a Project Coordinator for Digital Twin technologies and Ocean Data Management projects at the VLIZ Marine Data Centre (VMDC). 
The VLIZ Marine Data Centre (VMDC) is an international hub for marine and coastal data, connecting scientists, policymakers, and innovators worldwide. It manages vast collections of high-quality datasets, tools, and services that support cutting-edge ocean research and sustainable marine management. By working at VMDC, you contribute to advancing open science and support tackling global challenges such as climate change, biodiversity loss, and ocean health. The VMDC is built on collaboration, innovation, and a passion for the sea, offering a stimulating environment for professionals who want to make an impact. Joining VMDC means becoming part of a dynamic, international team dedicated to unlocking knowledge for a sustainable future of our oceans. 

We are currently looking for a Project Coordinator with an affinity for Digital Twin technologies 

and/or Ocean Data Management, to be a part of our Geospatial Data & Products (GD&P) team within 

VMDC. This team drives innovation in marine data by creating advanced data products, improving 

interoperability, and building next-generation data systems. The team is also involved in the project 

management and data management of several EU projects and initiatives (e.g. Marine Regions, 

EDITO, EMODnet, EOSC-Marine, SPHERE, Blue4All, ….).
 

YOUR TASKS 
 
 

• You oversee the successful implementation of the projects within the institute. In this context, you actively interact with a multidisciplinary project team. You coordinate work from up to 10/15 people of various backgrounds (Technical/IT, Communication, Researchers, Administrative, etc.). 

• You handle the necessary reporting in cooperation with the technological and administrative experts at VLIZ and the project partners. 

• You participate and/or organise project meetings and write down minutes. You coordinate and/or help (co-)organise events related to the projects (e.g. Projects Forum Day, Digital Ocean Forum, etc.). 

• You contribute, coordinate and/or review project deliverables and concept notes. 

• You follow-up on subcontractors’ work and reporting. 

• You represent VLIZ, serving as an ambassador for the institute along with colleagues, at national and international project meetings, within relevant networks, and participating in conferences. 

• You support and further develop the internal governance and management of related projects. 

• You take on the coordination of other ambitious data related projects. 

• You contribute to the expansion and valorisation of data systems and the expertise of the Data Centre. You define methods and approach for solving bottlenecks and gaps. 

• You make proposals with regards to new initiatives. You detect needs and proactively respond to the needs of scientists. 

• You proactively invest in building up the necessary knowledge and expertise (e.g. follow-up of relevant policies, scientific and technological developments, etc.).  

For each function, VLIZ considers enthusiastic involvement, service minded, excellent professionalism and integrity as important characteristics. 

YOUR PROFILE 
 
 

• You hold a master's degree (or PhD) in marine or related (biology, geography) sciences, applied sciences or similar (engineering, Informatics). 

• You have proven experience in managing European projects (Horizon Europe, H2020, etc.) with strategic and high-level expectance. 

• You can coordinate work from up to 10/15 people of various backgrounds (Technical/IT, Communication, Researchers, Administrative, etc.). 

• You have experience with internal and external written and oral reporting to various stakeholders. 

• You can coordinate various contributions and harmonize inputs in deliverables. 

• You have experience (co-)organising project meetings and project (external) events. 

• You have practical knowledge and/or experience with technical development of data systems. 

• You have practical knowledge and/or experience of procedures of scientific data management. 

• You have an affinity with the European Digital Twin of the Ocean, or equivalent digital twin related initiatives. 

• You have an affinity with the European Ocean Data Management community (EMODnet, CMEMS, EOSC, etc. aren’t unknown to you). 

• You can write fluently and communicate clearly in English. 

• You are eager to work in an international context.

This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely

What you will do

• Drive application quality from concept to deployment by preparing and executing functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance tests. 

• Partner with users, engineers, and developers to understand business processes, validate requirements, and ensure solutions meet operational needs. 

• Provide clear quality visibility by documenting test results, reporting quality metrics, managing defects, and delivering objective evidence to support deployment and Go/No-Go decisions. 

• Enable successful application adoption through user validation, training support, documentation, and readiness assessments. 

• Champion continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, refining testing practices, and helping raise quality standards across the organization. 

Who you are
 

You are a quality-driven professional who enjoys bridging technology and operations and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
 
 

• Strong expertise in software testing methodologies, including test planning, test design, requirements traceability, defect management, risk-based testing, and user acceptance testing. 

• A solid understanding of quality assurance best practices, with the ability to produce clear test documentation, execution reports, and objective quality assessments that support deployment decisions. If you hold an ISTQB certification, that’s a great bonus, but your mindset matters more. 

• At least 5 years of experience in application testing or QA engineering, preferably for operational, manufacturing, CIM, or MES-related systems. Experience in a manufacturing, semiconductor, or process-industry environment is a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. 
Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.
  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.
  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2+ years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

Location: [Braine / Gent / Mechelen / Customer / Hybrid / Remote]

Contract: [Full-time / Freelance]

Experience: 0-3 years

Department: Microsoft 365 AI Business Solutions

Start: [As soon as possible]

As a Junior Microsoft 365 Consultant, you'll deliver projects end‑to‑end with guidance from senior colleagues where needed. You'll co‑create roadmaps, implement governance, contribute to architecture, run content migrations, drive user adoption, and build intranets and lightweight applications (SPFx or Power Platform basics). You're hands‑on, structured, and comfortable facilitating workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
What you'll do

• Roadmapping & value realization (co‑ownership):

• Contribute to maturity assessments and propose phased roadmaps aligned to business goals (collaboration, knowledge, security, AI readiness)

• Translate plans into backlogs, milestones, and success metrics (adoption, governance KPIs)

• Governance (collaboration, content & apps):

• Implement governance controls for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive: naming, lifecycle, provisioning, guest access, external sharing

• Help set up request & approval flows, templates, and site owner responsibilities; contribute to CoE practices

• Architecture (contribution & implementation):

• Contribute to tenant/site architectures (hub/site topology, Entra ID patterns) and information architecture (metadata, content types, navigation, audience targeting)

• Support solution architecture for basic SPFx and Power Platform solutions; follow environment strategy and basic ALM guidance

• Data migrations & modernization:

• Plan and execute content migrations (SharePoint Server, file shares, classic → modern) using tools like Shargate or custom PowerShell scripting

• Perform quality controls on executed migrations

• Perform content discovery, mapping, permissions & version remediation, pilot/cutover, and post‑migration validation with clear runbooks

• User adoption & change enablement:

• Co‑lead adoption activities: use‑case discovery, champions network, training, comms, and enablement assets

• Track impact via Adoption Score and usage analytics; iterate based on feedback

• Intranets & employee experience:

• Build SharePoint Online intranets: structure (hubs), page templates, audience targeting, search tuning, and governance for site owners

• Configure Viva Connections basics (dashboard, resources) when applicable

• Applications in m365 (SPFx & power platform - basics):

• Deliver lightweight solutions:

• SPFx: simple web parts/extensions for UI, branding, or navigation widgets

• Power Platform: Power Apps (canvas basics) and Power Automate flows for approvals and process automation

• Apply secure‑by‑default practices (permissions, data protection, DLP awareness) and document solutions

• Operations, documentation & handover:

• Produce solution docs, runbooks, admin guides; perform handover to operations and site owners

• Contribute to presales (effort estimates, scoping notes) with support from senior team members

• Already an experience delivering Microsoft 365 projects across governance, information architecture, content migrations, intranets, and user adoption

• Solid hands‑on with SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and familiarity with Entra ID (identity & access basics, Conditional Access patterns)

• Lightweight app skills (one or both):

• SPFx basics (TypeScript/React fundamentals for web parts/extensions), and/or

• Power Platform basics (Power Apps, Power Automate, environment usage, simple ALM)

• Nice to have / Plus:

• PowerShell for administration & automation (PnP or Graph exposure)

• Purview fundamentals (sensitivity labels, retention, basic DLP concepts) and ability to collaborate with security/compliance teams

• Strong workshop facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication

• Languages: English + Dutch and/or French (one of the two national language is mandatory)

• Certifications (nice to have): MS‑102, MD‑102, MS‑700, SC‑900/200/300/400, MS‑900, PL‑900 (or equivalent experience)

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer Polish-Dutch-English, you are the first point of contact for customers from all over Europe. You handle phone calls and emails professionally, quickly switching between Polish, Dutch, and English. You gather information, ensure proper follow-up, and provide technical support in case of breakdowns or logistical questions. Thanks to your efforts, vehicles get back on the road quickly and you help customers when they need it most.

A typical workday is varied: you answer calls, juggle multiple cases, communicate with garages, and keep customers and partners informed of the latest updates. You work in a small, close-knit team where everyone supports each other. During busier periods, you may work on Saturdays. Your shifts are flexible, between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Are you ready to use your language skills and problem-solving abilities in a warm, international environment? Apply today and discover new challenges every day, meet unique people, and further develop your talents!

• You are fluent in Polish, Dutch, and English (other languages are a plus)

• You are comfortable working with computers and proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• You communicate clearly and efficiently by phone and email

• You are customer-focused, stress-resistant, and work accurately

• You are solution-oriented and enjoy variety in your work

• Experience in a similar position or technical knowledge is a plus, but not required

• You have at least a higher secondary education (associate or bachelor’s degree)

• You are willing to work in shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday through Friday (occasional Saturdays)
